items: Press ground beef in a greased 9x13-inch pan.
Put a layer of carrots over meat and then a layer of potatoes on top of the carrots. Put mushrooms on with potatoes.
Combine the soups and add the milk. Pour over the top.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for an hour to an hour and a half or until vegetables are tender.

notes.title: Open questions
items: How many carrots and potatoes? (The source gives no amounts; "a layer" of each.)
